components.name: Stack
components.signature: Stack(children: (Text | Badge | Callout | KeyValue | Table | Stat | Progress | Steps | BarChart | LineChart | PaperCard | FigureRef | ClaimList | Outline | Timeline | Tree | TagList | SourceList | Row | Card)[], gap?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: vertical root container

components.name: Row
components.signature: Row(children: (Text | Badge | Callout | KeyValue | Table | Stat | Progress | Steps | BarChart | LineChart | PaperCard | FigureRef | ClaimList | Outline | Timeline | Tree | TagList | SourceList)[], gap?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
components.description: horizontal row; wraps on narrow screens

components.name: Card
components.signature: Card(title: string, children: (Text | Badge | Callout | KeyValue | Table | Stat | Progress | Steps | BarChart | LineChart | PaperCard | FigureRef | ClaimList | Outline | Timeline | Tree | TagList | SourceList | Row)[])
components.description: titled container for a group of components

components.name: Text
components.signature: Text(markdown: string, variant?: "body" | "heading" | "caption")
components.description: Markdown text; variant body|heading|caption

components.name: Badge
components.signature: Badge(label: string, tone?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
components.description: small status pill

components.name: Callout
components.signature: Callout(title: string, body: string, tone?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
components.description: short note with tone info|success|warning|danger

components.name: KeyValue
components.signature: KeyValue(items: {label: string, value: string | number}[])
components.description: label/value rows for metadata

components.name: Table
components.signature: Table(columns: string[], rows: string[][], caption?: string)
components.description: data table; prefer a Markdown table when it is the whole answer

components.name: Stat
components.signature: Stat(label: string, value: string, hint?: string)
components.description: one key number with an optional hint

components.name: Progress
components.signature: Progress(label: string, value: number, max?: number)
components.description: progress bar; max defaults to 100

components.name: Steps
components.signature: Steps(title: string, steps: string[])
components.description: ordered steps

components.name: BarChart
components.signature: BarChart(title: string, labels: string[], values: number[], unit?: string)
components.description: categorical bars; labels and values must be equal length

components.name: LineChart
components.signature: LineChart(title: string, labels: string[], values: number[], unit?: string)
components.description: values over labels; labels and values must be equal length

components.name: PaperCard
components.signature: PaperCard(paper: {title: string, authors: string, year?: string, venue?: string, path?: string, status?: "unread" | "reading" | "read" | "queued", tags?: string[]})
components.description: paper identity card: title, authors, year, venue, status, tags and vault path

components.name: FigureRef
components.signature: FigureRef(label: string, caption?: string, source?: string, kind?: "figure" | "table" | "equation" | "algorithm" | "section")
components.description: reference card for a figure, table, equation, algorithm or section

components.name: ClaimList
components.signature: ClaimList(title: string, claims: {claim: string, status: "supports" | "contradicts" | "mixed" | "unclear", evidence?: string, source?: string}[])
components.description: claims with support/contradict/mixed/unclear status, evidence and source

components.name: Outline
components.signature: Outline(title: string, sections: {title: string, level?: number, page?: number, source?: string}[])
components.description: paper outline with nesting, page numbers and optional section source

components.name: Timeline
components.signature: Timeline(title?: string, items: {title: string, description?: string}[])
components.description: vertical timeline of titled items

components.name: Tree
components.signature: Tree(title?: string, items: {label: string, depth?: number}[])
components.description: indented tree; depth starts at 0

components.name: TagList
components.signature: TagList(tags: string[])
components.description: wrapped tag pills

components.name: SourceList
components.signature: SourceList(sources: {label: string, detail?: string, path?: string}[])
components.description: source list with a label, optional detail and source path
